Title: Fine Grained Ship Detection in High Resolution Satellite Images With Shape Aware Feature Learning
ModelBackbone: Ship Instance Switching (SIS): works before the ResNet backbone. The input is the original image and the output is the switched one. For each instance in the input original image, we judge whether its category is rare or not, calculate the size, aspect ratio, and background color of the instance belonging to the rare class, and concatenate these characteristics into KNN [52] for the following instance matching
ModelNeck: For each RoI generated by the RPN, instead of just using the single-level FPN feature, shape-aware rotate RoI (SRRA) align is performed on the feature map of each level of the FPN. It takes the shape characteristics into account, paying more attention to the long side to balance the fine-grained features of the short and long sides. Finally, the extracted multilevel features are accumulated together, followed by a spatial attention module to weigh the fused features to guide the learning of the detector
Strengths: Method for ship detection for high aspect-ratio ships, fixing the problem of feature misalignment during RoI assignment and extraction. Shape-aware ship instance switching method to solve the quantity imbalance in different categories. Guarantee the consistency of the ocean background and ship direction when replacing common ship instances with rare ship instances, which greatly improves the network’s learning ability of rare instances. AP gains up to +4.9 (AP75 MCSD), +4.0 (AP50:95 ShipRSImageNet)
Weaknesses: No major gains for small ships; relies on expensive directional OBB annotations

Hardware: Intel Core i7-8700K CPU NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPU
Strengths: Method can expand the scope of angle to [0-360), and distinguish between bow and stern. Custom dataset. mAP = 87.91% (FGSD2021); high accuracy; anchor-free; NMS-free; good small-object performance. Frequently cited on the literature
Weaknesses: Long training time; requires precise head-direction annotation; limited generalization to datasets without head labels

Title: Lightweight Feature Fusion for Small Ship Detection in RS Imagery
ModelNeck: Multi-scale Sequential Information Fusion MSIF + PAN-like bidirectional fusion
Strengths: Model trained with dataset specific customized for small ships under various environmental challenges (including clouds, fog, darkness, waves, islands, and reef interference). The average object size in the AITOD dataset is approximately 12.8×12.8 pixel, which is notably smaller compared to other datasets. Additionally, the DOTA dataset also contains some small ship objects. Achieves significant performance to identify and detect small ship objects in scenes with limited object features and complex environmental interference; MASATI AP=80.5%; Small Ship AP=74.7%; Lightweight (10.89M params, 45.6 GFLOPs)
Weaknesses: NA

Weaknesses: Private dataset used

Title: A Transformer Based Model for Efficient Ship Detection in Complex Maritime Environments
ModelHead: RT-DETR transformer decoder with HiLo attention and HWD downsampling
Strengths:
mAP=75.7% (LEVIR-Ship); mAP=73.1% (HRSC2016-MS); improved precision and small-ship detection; The HiLo attention optimizes the feature expression process by separating high-frequency and low-frequency features. This separation and fusion of features not only enhances
the model’s ability to detect ship detail texture features but also strengthens its robustness in complex backgrounds, enabling the model to better distinguish subtle differences between ships and the background. Demonstrates superior detection accuracy while maintaining a relatively small number of parameters and computational load
Weaknesses: NA

Title: Hybrid Anchor Rotation Detector for OOD
ModelHead: Hybrid RPN (Anchor-free + Anchor-based refinement with Orientation-Aware Convolution) + R-CNN rotated bbox heads (Rotated RoIAlign)
ImageSize: DOTA: 4000x4000 crops → 1024x1024; DIOR-R: 800x800; HRSC: 300x300–1500x900 (resized to 800x512 for training)
ImageProcessing: Random flip; Cropping; Standard augmentation used in benchmarks
Strengths: Rigorous and wide comparison with SOTA methods for all model classes. Competitive oriented detection: DOTA mAP=75.41 (ResNet50), 76.02 (ResNet101), 77.01 (ResNeXt101-DCNv2); DIOR-R mAP=65.3 highest accuracy; HRSC2016 mAP=90.20 and 95.32 mAP on the VOC2007 and VOC2012 metrics, respectively. Computational efficiency, achieved via a reduced anchor set and lightweight orientation-aware refinement, makes it deployable on edge devices such as drones or lowpower remote sensing platforms.
Weaknesses: NA

Title: A Unified DL Approach for Ship Detection in Complex Maritime Environments
ImageProcessing: H/V flips; Random affine (translation/rotation/scaling); Conversion of colored instance masks to grayscale
Strengths: Pixel Accuracy = 95.26%; Dice Ratio = 0.6725; IoU = 0.5652 after 200 epochs
Weaknesses:
Although the algorithm performs well, there is still potential for enhancement due to the intricate ship backgrounds, a wide range of classes and angles, as well as difficulties in accurately detecting ships located near shores or on land. Future research will focus on
developing more precise detection methods, incorporating advanced data augmentation, multi-scale feature fusion, and optimized real-time processing to handle diverse maritime environments.

Title: In Context Vision Pattern Language Model for Enhancing Vessel Activity Explanation AIS
ModelHead: CLIP-based zero-shot classifier + RAG-based explanation generator
Strengths: Designed to enhance the explanation and detection of illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) vessel activities. The strengths of the proposed VPL model include its robust integration of satellite imagery with Automatic Identification System (AIS)
Weaknesses:
Not designed for bounding-box ship detection (focuses on trajectory pattern classification and explanation); evaluation primarily used predefined datasets, raising questions about its robustness in real-world environment. Furthermore, the significant computational
resources required for its fusion and classification algorithms present practical hurdles for real-time deployment

Title: Multi Scale Ship Detection Framework in Optical RS Images and New Benchmark
Strengths: MSSDet achieves multi-scale ship detection performance through enhanced FPN and feature calibration modules. Authors consider that non-oriented detectors perform better for small ships because tiny targets lack reliable orientation cues, making angle prediction noisy and unnecessary while horizontal boxes remain simpler, more stable, and more accurate. Proposed JRFP architecture and also showed that the proposed method has excellent generalizability. Comparisons with SOTA methods showed that the proposed method achieves competitive performance: mAP 77.3%, 95.8%, and 73.3% on the HRSC2016-MS, HRSC2016, and DIOR datasets, respectively.
Weaknesses: Limitations of non-oriented detection methods.Anchor-based design remains sensitive to extreme aspect ratios and densely packed small ships. Insufficient ability to extract context information, bamboo rafts are detected by mistake. Authors consider problems like this can be solved by oriented detection mechanism, more abundant context information, and a more extensive and diverse dataset

Title: Contrastive Learning for Fine Grained Ship Classification in RS Images
ModelHead: Push-out contrastive module + Pull-in proxy-based integration module
ImageProcessing: H/V flips; Random crop; Random scale; Random gaussian blur; Random rotation
Strengths: SOTA accuracy on FGSC-23 and FGSCR-42; higher AA than prior methods, Asynchronous contrastive push-and-pull where input images are first decorrelated with each other and then aggregated into subclasses.improves handling of imbalanced fineness and appearances. The proposed P2Net leverages the idea of CL and consists of a push-out part and a pull-in part that perform the above two processes, respectively. With the two parts, our network can decouple the subclasses, and thus make the classification much easier. All the network components in our method do not require extra annotations and can be trained in an end-to-end fashion.
Weaknesses: NA

Title: Small Ship Detection Based on Hybrid Anchor Structure and Feature Super Resolution
